title: Build a Consistent Study Routine
message:
Consistency is the foundation of exam success.

A well-structured study routine helps you retain more information and reduces last-minute pressure.

Tips for building a strong routine:

- Study at the same time each day
- Break large topics into smaller sections
- Review past questions regularly
- Take short breaks to stay focused
- Track your progress with the app's analytics

Visit our blog for detailed guidance on creating a study schedule that works for you.
